subject: FieldPilot POC results: short quote & publish permission
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@retailify.com>, Dan Patel <dan.patel@retailify.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 29, 2026 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: FieldPilot POC results: short quote & publish permission

Hi Alicia / Dan —

Thanks again for running the FieldPilot POC with us last month. We pulled together a short one-page summary (attached) with the key signals your team and ours tracked during the trial. Quick highlights: 
- 42% median inference latency reduction on 0.5–2s tails
- 2.1x effective throughput at 95th percentile concurrency (same GPU estate)
- ~38% reduction in per-1M-token cost with caching + batching profile
- Error/utility regressions were within the expected noise band (0.6% decrease in task accuracy across the sampled prompts)

Would Retailify be comfortable providing a 1–2 sentence quote we can use alongside these results, and permission to publish the metrics + company name in a short case study? If a quick call is easier, would you be available for a 15-minute sync next week (Tue/Wed) to confirm wording?

Attached: FieldPilot_POC_Summary.pdf (summary + test plan + example prompts).

If you prefer we anonymize any numbers or redact specifics, say the word and we’ll do that.

Thanks — excited about the results and potential next steps.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0148

---

Thanks Olga — great summary and congrats to both teams. Retailify is happy to provide a short blurb and to be named. Quick quote you can use: 
"Redwood’s inference platform reduced latency and materially improved throughput for our production NLP pipelines during the POC, enabling faster feature delivery with lower infra spend."

We’re fine with the metrics as presented in the one-pager. If you need a sign-off from procurement/legal, loop Dan and I and we’ll route it. Otherwise, a 15-minute call Tue @ 10am PT works for me to finalise the language.

—
